continue skips the rest of the current iteration, while break exits the loop. The loop stops after two accepted values. Appending with [] creates consecutive keys, so JSON encodes a list. array_sum($accepted) takes the array and returns the numeric sum of its entries. In this fixture every entry is already a validated integer, so the returned total is the bounded integer sum rather than a count of entries.
